content_data.meeting_title: Strategic Alignment of AI Ethics Frameworks for Global Education Policy
agenda_items: Discussion on challenges of implementing AI governance in diverse educational contexts.
Establishment of working groups for policy recommendation drafting.
key_decisions: Form an inter-agency working group to synthesize regional educational technology policies.
Adopt principles from the UNESCO AI Ethics Recommendation as a foundational baseline.
action_items: All attendees to review the preliminary framework draft and provide feedback by +7 days.
Dr. Anya Sharma to draft a comparative analysis of existing national AI education policies by +14 days.
Professor Kenji Tanaka to lead the working group on data governance and algorithmic accountability, with initial findings due in +30 days.
Ms. Lena Petrova to coordinate outreach with key educational technology providers for input on practical implementation challenges within the next 3 weeks.
